title: Agent Trust Infrastructure (ATI): A Federated Identity, Trust, Attestation, and Accountability Architecture for Cross-Organization Autonomous AI Agents
abstract: arXiv:2611.23202v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: AI agents increasingly collaborate across organizational boundaries, invoking tools and interacting with agents operated by independent entities. Although existing agent frameworks support planning and coordination, they lack a common mechanism for verifying cross-organizational agent identity, execution integrity, and authorization. We propose the Agent Trust Infrastructure (ATI), a framework-independent security architecture built on Public Key Infrastructure (PKI), Zero Trust Architecture (ZTA), and remote attestation. ATI establishes federated trust through peer organizational certificate authorities (AgentCAs), eliminating the need for a shared root authority. Before executing requests, ATI validates agent certificates, verifies approved model, tool, and system-prompt configurations, and enforces authorization through three policy checks. We implement ATI as an external security enforcement layer that integrates with existing agent

translated_title: 智能体信任基础设施（ATI）：面向跨组织自主AI智能体的联邦身份、信任、证明与问责架构
translated_abstract: AI智能体越来越多地跨越组织边界进行协作，调用工具并与由独立实体运营的智能体交互。尽管现有的智能体框架支持规划与协调，但它们缺乏验证跨组织智能体身份、执行完整性和授权的通用机制。我们提出了智能体信任基础设施（ATI），这是一种独立于框架的安全架构，建立在公钥基础设施（PKI）、零信任架构（ZTA）和远程证明之上。ATI通过对等的组织级证书颁发机构（AgentCA）建立联邦信任，从而消除了对共享根授权机构的需求。在执行请求之前，ATI会验证智能体证书、核实经批准的模型、工具和系统提示配置，并通过三项策略检查强制执行授权。我们将ATI实现为一个可集成到现有智能体系统的外部安全执行层……
tldr: 本文提出智能体信任基础设施（ATI），一种基于PKI、零信任架构和远程证明、独立于框架的安全架构，通过对等组织证书颁发机构建立联邦信任，在跨组织AI智能体执行请求前验证其身份、执行完整性与授权。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes Agent Trust Infrastructure (ATI), a framework-independent security architecture built on PKI, Zero Trust Architecture, and remote attestation, which establishes federated trust through peer organizational certificate authorities and validates agent identity, execution integrity, and authorization before cross-organizational requests are executed.
